name: Sabrak Norker

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: Small creatures occupy the same space as Medium creatures, but they face some restrictions in the weapons they can wield: • You can’t use two-handed weapons, such as greatswords and halberds. • When you use a versatile weapon, such as a longsword, you must use it two-handed, but you don’t deal additional damage for doing so.

hit.description: damage plus 1 extra damage per norker ally adjacent to the target.

powers.name: Elemental Rebuke
powers.trigger: An enemy reduces the norker to 0 hit points.

attacks.name: Attack
attacks.targets: the triggering enemy in the burst
